name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover window water leak repairs?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover window water leak repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance coverage for window water leak repairs depends on the cause of the leak. Sudden and accidental damage, like storm damage, is often covered. However, damage resulting from neglect, poor maintenance, or long-term issues like wear and tear typically isn't. It's best to review your specific policy or contact your insurance provider for clarification on your coverage.
